'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***[[2022 Herat mosque bombing]]
****Eighteen people are killed and 23 others are injured by a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] at a [[Sunni Islam|Sunni]] [[mosque]] in [[Herat]], [[Afghanistan]]. The mosque's pro-[[Taliban]] [[imam]], who is suspected to be the target of the attack, is among the dead. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blast-afghan-mosque-kills-cleric-civilians-police-2022-09-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[2022 Huila attack]]
***Seven policemen are killed and one is injured during an [[ambush]] in [[Huila Department]], [[Colombia]]. Their vehicle hit a [[roadside bomb]] before being shot dead by gunmen. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-62775585 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man stabs and injures an [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldier]] near [[Kiryat Arba]] in the [[West Bank]]. The attacker is shot dead by security forces. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-israel-west-bank-0dbdda0114c8e3bbe2f5987ae1c4ba79 (AP)]
*The [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian Navy]] captures and later releases two [[United States Navy|American]] [[Unmanned surface vehicle|sea drones]] in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/iran-seizes-2-us-sea-drones-in-second-incident-this-week/ar-AA11oYo6 (MSN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present global energy crisis]]
**The [[G7]] group of nations announce plans for a price cap on Russian oil. [[Russia]] vows to halt sales to countries imposing it. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/g7-finance-chiefs-seen-advancing-russian-oil-price-cap-plan-2022-09-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**Following the G7's announcement, Russia's [[Gazprom]] announces that flows through the [[Nord Stream 1]] [[natural gas pipeline]] to Europe will not resume tomorrow because of a reported "oil leak" in a turbine. It did not give a new time frame. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russia-scraps-gas-pipeline-reopening-stoking-european-fears-2022-09-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62766867 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Hurricane Danielle becomes the first hurricane of the [[Atlantic]] season. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/09/02/weather/danielle-season-first-hurricane/index.html (CNN)]
*A double–decker bus overturned on the Gala road between [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]] and [[Suez Governorate]], killing eight and injuring 38. [https://www.egypttoday.com/Article/1/118855/Photos-8-killed-38-injured-as-bus-overturned-in-Galala (Egypt Today)]
*A [[Toyota Innova]] rams into a group of pedestrian devotees in [[Aravalli Range]], [[India]], killing seven and critically injuring five others.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/ahmedabad/7-dead-innova-rams-devotees-gujarats-aravalli-8127190/?ref=archive_pg | title=7 dead as Innova rams into devotees in Gujarat’s Aravalli | date=September 2, 2022 }}</ref>
*Three people were killed and 11 others were injured when a train crashed into a microbus in [[Northern Egypt]]. [https://www.egypttoday.com/Article/1/118850/Photos-3-killed-11-injured-in-train-microbus-collision-in (Egypt Today)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Deposed leader of [[Myanmar]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] is sentenced to three years in prison after being found guilty of [[election fraud]]. She will now serve an overall sentence of 20 years in prison for different charges. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/2/myanmars-aung-san-suu-kyi-gets-3-years-prison-for-election-fraud (Al Jazeera)]

**Former [[President of Sri Lanka|president]] [[Gotabaya Rajapaksa]] returns to [[Colombo]], [[Sri Lanka]], after seven weeks of [[exile]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-sri-lanka-government-and-politics-1e2677e8a3f82064b619d0035bee2399 (AP)]
